description: A chat's sign-in to Claude, as its host has it: every head draws the chat's sign-in card from this alone (LoginCard), whichever head started what's going on.

state.description: needed: a turn failed for want of signing in (and a sign-in started since was cancelled); signing_in: claude auth login runs on the host for it; signed_in: it finished; failed: it ended without signing in.

expired.description: needed because the sign-in there was ran out (expired, reached its time limit, can't be renewed), not because there's none.

reason.description: needed: the first sentence of Claude's own error; failed: why the sign-in didn't finish.

who.description: signed_in: who as, as claude auth status says it; null if it didn't say.
